recommendation: Keep the source fix. It restores the final Patient Care decision for FHIR-40760 while preserving the later applied Communication scope clarifications; no separate generated-output change is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-40760 was an Applied Patient Care change request for Communication section 8.22.2. It asked to clarify the Boundaries and Relationships text; the final Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected the proposed human-recipient wording and exchange-protocol link because Communication.recipient is not always human and the exchange guidance is already covered elsewhere, and instead approved wording that the resource records a communication that has occurred or will occur.
initial_application: The issue was first applied by commit ed2ad0f22f37e3634066932e9b8e642d8c146e0c in PR #2958, which changed the paragraph from the original past-only wording to 'This resource is a record of a communication that has occurred or will occur.' Earlier commit 4ee3abce0078aa8eb8971b118f46af8920c12640 contained the reporter's superseded human-recipient proposal, but that was not the Jira resolution.
additional_context: Later Applied issues FHIR-40214 and FHIR-28235 refined the same paragraph to allow Communication to represent an in-progress communication flow in some use cases and changed the first sentence to 'has occurred or where the communication process has at least initiated.' Commit 40aa5c88300a803dc5d821194e74821ab60e2340 implemented those later decisions. A December 2023 merge of the stale gotdan-communication-1 branch for FHIR-40760 then combined the superseded human-recipient proposal with the later approved wording, leaving the current source broader and more confusing than either final Jira decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/communication/communication-introduction.xml so the active Communication narrative uses the later approved FHIR-28235/FHIR-40214 wording while removing the human-recipient framing and redundant exchange-protocol link that FHIR-40760 explicitly declined.

related_jiras.note: Approved the actual-flow clarification for the same Communication boundaries paragraph, constraining the correct post-FHIR-40760 wording.
Replaced the literal FHIR-40760 'will occur' wording with 'where the communication process has at least initiated,' so this reconciliation preserves that later approved text.
